title: SG-Bench: Evaluating LLM Safety Generalization Across Diverse Tasks and Prompt Types
reasoning: SG-Bench is designed to evaluate LLM safety generalization, which includes categories such as 'toxic content', 'stereotyping and bias', and 'malicious use'. These categories are directly derived from and used to evaluate models against human moral and ethical standards. The paper specifically discusses 'human values' and categorizes model responses based on the presence of ethical reminders.
